_template_rule: Foreman: set lr to the stage-A learning rate with the lowest held-out loss among 3e-4 (rung6_base_heldout), 1e-3 (rung6_lr1e3) and 3e-3 (tune_rung6_lr3e-3). Then add each change among warmup15 {warmup_frac 0.15, warmup_max 2000}, clip3 {grad_clip 3.0}, wd0.1 {weight_decay 0.1} and decoder_norm {decoder_norm true} whose held-out loss is lower than rung6_base_heldout by more than 0.01. If no change qualifies and the best lr is 3e-4, do not run this trial. Delete this key before submission. Full rule: cruxvault/results/ladder_tuning/rung6/PLAN.md.
